objects.name: base
objects.prompt: A compact stockpile of freshly mined metal ore for a fantasy goblin settlement, arranged in a tidy but slightly irregular heap. Rough, angular chunks of dark grey and blue-grey rock containing visible veins and flecks of metallic ore in rusty copper, dull silver and warm iron-brown tones. Some pieces have exposed mineral surfaces that catch the light with subtle metallic highlights. Uneven fractured edges, natural variations in size and shape, and a practical, rustic appearance. Designed as a stored mining resource for a cute underground colony simulator. Whimsical dark fairy-tale aesthetic, cute fantasy pixel art, fixed three-quarter JRPG perspective, 32×32 pixel sprite, crisp pixel placement, thick clean black outlines, limited harmonious colour palette, subtle shading, clear readable silhouette, transparent background, isolated object, no scenery, no text.
